name: cerocode-monorepo
author: AbhishekSinghDev <abhishek.code.tech@gmail.com>
description: Monorepo for cerocode — a terminal AI coding agent (TUI CLI, Hono server, shared schemas, database)

scripts.build: bun run --filter cerocode build && bun run --filter @cerocode/server build
scripts.link:cli: bun run build:cli && cd packages/cli && bun link
scripts.clean: bun run --filter cerocode clean && bun run --filter @cerocode/server clean && git clean -xdf node_modules
